ai_summary: 63 moons technologies limited issued a clarification regarding a recently circulated, stale article from Law Text misrepresenting a February 2025 Bombay High Court judgment related to the NSEL scam and MPID Act as a fresh ruling against the Company. This misleading publication coincided with significant intraday stock volatility, prompting the Company to investigate potential market manipulation and consider legal action against those responsible for creating a false market impression. The Company urged investors to rely solely on official disclosures to avoid being misled by such information.
